rationale: Stable v1.82.0 already opens HA device dialogs, but a thermometer auto-icon can target a measurement instead of the functional thermostat. Fix that existing behavior and offer an explicit own-entity target, preserving presentation and control actions.

summary.ru: Правильное открытие термостатов и выбор сущности для диалога HA.
summary.en: Correct thermostat dialogs and an explicit own-entity target for HA opening.

golden.reason: Own-entity picker below More Info, with internal search and actual saved selection.
The same standard picker and long entity names fit a 360px device dialog.
